**the MVP instruction set has no XOR**
25 M+J (can_tx 5 + stuff detector 20, fw/can/CANNOT-EXPRESS.md)

effects.rationale: CRC-15 step per received bit with the XOR operation, anchored on fw/can/CANNOT-EXPRESS.md which counts the same step at 30+ instructions per bit without it. Sketch with the assumed XOR (op 11, dst ^= src): the running CRC lives left-justified in the OSR, the polynomial (left-justified) in Y. Per data bit: `out x, 1` (X = CRC msb; the OUT also shifts the register, so the shift is free), `mov x, x ^ pins` (fold in the line bit), `jmp !x, next`, `mov osr, osr ^ y` = 4 instructions per bit, versus the 30+ instructions per bit for the XOR alone that CANNOT-EXPRESS.md counts without it. Plus set-up and the final compare/ACK (about 6 words). Register pressure is the uncertainty: fw/can's stuff detector already uses the OSR as its window source, so the CRC may have to be spilled through the ISR (more words and cycles), hence the wide high end. The shipped can_tx loop (5 words) plus stuff detector (20 words) already use 25 of 32 IMEM words, so +10 words is 35: it does NOT fit at the nominal count and fits only at the low end (+6 = 31).
effects.src: J: hand sketch scaled from fw/can/CANNOT-EXPRESS.md (CRC-15 feedback count without XOR)

effects.rationale: No program exists. The workload's reflex_sm 8 is a judgement for a 3-opcode bit tree (tools/archsim/PLAN.md Appendix A.3): in M0 each opcode test is a constant load (SET holds only 5 bits, so an 8-bit command needs a multi-instruction load) plus `jmp x != y`, about 3-4 SM cycles per level; with x == imm and pin-edge conditions each test is one instruction. Assumed 12-20 of the 40 words and 6-10 of the 8 cycles are tree overhead, so -10 words (-16 to -4) and -4 cycles (-6 to -2). The repo does not itemise the 40 words: this is a wide guess; at 40-10 = 30 words the program would fit 32, at -4 (36) it would not.

With a pin-edge condition (SDA rising while SCL is high) the loop becomes `jmp edge, stop_path` / `jmp pin, poll` / `jmp data` (3 words, 2 SM cycles), no counter and no patched constant: -2 words (-3 to 0 depending on whether the edge latch needs a clearing instruction).
